When is the Mega Millions drawing

The Mega Millions drawing is held twice a week, on Wednesdays and Saturdays at 4 a.m.. To play the game, you must choose five white numbers from 1 to 70 and one gold Mega Ball number from 1 to 25. If you match all six numbers, you win the Mega Millions jackpot. To purchase tickets for the Mega Millions draw, visit Play Lottos on LottosOnline and good luck beating the numbers!

Frequently Asked Questions

When is the Mega Millions draw in the United Kingdom?

The Mega Millions draw takes place every Tuesday and Friday at 4 a.m. in the United Kingdom. 

What are the chances of winning the Mega Millions in the United Kingdom?

According to the official Mega Millions website, the odds of winning the jackpot are 1 in 302,575,350!

When do Mega Millions drawings happen?

The Mega Millions drawing time happens every Wednesday and Saturday morning at 4:00 a.m. UK time. Players can purchase tickets up until 3:45 a.m. UK time on the morning of the drawing. Up for the mega millions next drawing? Waste no time get your tickets and try out your luck at winning the jackpot!

How Mega Millions Winners are Selected?

Mega Millions is an exciting lottery game that takes place every Wednesday and Saturday at 4 a.m. UK time. The jackpot starts at $40 million and grows until someone wins it. But how does the process of selecting a winner work? Every time the draw takes place, five white balls are chosen from a pool of 70, along with one gold Mega Ball from a second pool of 25. To win the Mega Millions jackpot, the player must match all six numbers. If no one matches all six numbers, the prize is rolled over to the next draw. All other prizes, including the Megaplier, are determined by matching the number of balls you have selected. Winners of secondary prizes will be determined by a random number generator, which is programmed according to the number of balls that have been chosen by players in their tickets! 

What is the Chance of winning Mega Millions Jackpot?

The overall odds of winning any prize in Mega Millions is approximately 1 in 24. Despite the daunting odds, millions of people buy tickets for each Mega Millions drawing, hoping to become one of the lucky winners!

Most common Mega Millions numbers?

The most common numbers chosen by Mega Millions players are 70, 2, 45, 42, 60, and 1. These numbers have been chosen more often than any other combination of numbers in the history of the game, and have made the lucky winners. While there is no guarantee that these numbers will always be the most popular, they have been picked so often that they may be worth considering when choosing your own combination of lottery numbers.

What to do if my numbers match winning numbers?

A Mega Millions winner can either claim the prize in installments over a period of 29 years, or as a one-time cash option. The cash option is a single payment that's worth a little less than the full jackpot prize. The current Mega Millions jackpot is now the sixth-highest in U.S. history at $500 million. If someone hits all six numbers, it will be the fourth-largest lottery prize ever. The biggest Mega Millions jackpot was won on March 30, 2012, when three winners shared a record-breaking $656 million prize.

Biggest Mega Millions prizes and jackpots?

The biggest Mega Millions prizes and jackpots are ever-growing and reaching new heights! The largest Mega Millions prize to date was won in October 2018, when an anonymous winner from South Carolina took home a whopping $1.537 billion. This record-breaking prize has yet to be surpassed and is sure to remain the largest Mega Millions payout until at least 2022. For those hoping to become the next big Mega Millions winner, the jackpot starts at $40 million and increases with each rollover. It's safe to say that the chance of winning one of the biggest Mega Millions prizes and jackpots available will only increase as time goes by.
